title: Restore operational deadline rules to the effectiveness-critical set

outcomes.statement: testing/critical-paths.md declares twelve effectiveness-critical business rules instead of nine, so the nine stories governed by BR-08, BR-11 and BR-14 owe mutation evidence before they can close.
outcomes.demo: Diff testing/critical-paths.md against its previous state: exactly three rows are added (BR-08, BR-11, BR-14) with the governing stories the graph carries, and nothing else changes.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the regenerated file's governing-story lists match the authored 09b prose, which lists fewer stories per rule than the graph carries.
uncertainties.resolution: The generated file reads governed_by EDGES (materialized from the 10b story Meta rows, IMP-308), not the 09b prose or the extract's governed_by array. The graph is authoritative and was verified directly: BR-08 <- US-015/017/032/046, BR-11 <- US-022/052/053, BR-14 <- US-024/042. The prose disagreeing is a separate, unflagged substrate divergence and is not in scope here.
